articles.title: A Star That's Also a Black Hole? Meet the 'Black Hole Star'
articles.summary: Astronomers found a weird red dot in space that acts like a star but is way too bright. They think it's a black hole wrapped in a giant gas cloud, and they're calling it a 'black hole star.'

articles.title: Tako the Piano-Playing Octopus Says Goodbye to the Stage
articles.summary: An octopus named Tako learned to play a special piano with pull-keys and a crab elevator. After six months of practice, he became a star, but now he's retiring to rest in his tank.

articles.title: The Dodo Wasn't Dumb—It Might Have Been a Night Owl!
articles.summary: Scientists scanned dodo skulls and found their brains were not small for their size. The part for seeing was tiny, like in night birds. So dodos may have been active at night, not stupid!
